exam_scheme.note: Common University Entrance Test [CUET (UG)] is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode across India and abroad. The examination provides a single-window admission test for undergraduate programmes across all Central Universities (such as Delhi University, BHU, JNU, AMU, Jamia Millia Islamia) and over 280+ participating State, Deemed, and Private universities. Candidates can choose up to 5 subjects from 37 available subjects (13 Indian languages, 23 domain-specific subjects, and 1 General Aptitude Test).
